text_or_logos.what: small garbled brand wordmark printed on the watch dial (reads like a 4-6 letter logo)

notes: Watch dial carries a tiny printed brand mark — must be cleaned or the watch re-rendered with a blank dial. Otherwise no text, labels or signage anywhere: globe continents are flat gold shapes with no country names, bag face is blank, headphones have no brand mark. Bag handle rope passes oddly — the left rope end disappears behind the ribbon with no visible anchor point. Bag's top-right corner geometry is slightly inconsistent with the front face plane (the opening tilts more than the body). Headphone right earcup overlaps the bag edge with a soft, slightly melted contact edge. Lower-right ribbon coil is a loose spiral with ends that do not resolve.
